newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's defence chief has surgery in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's defence chief has surgery in U.S.

text.p: Croatian Defence Minister Gojko Susak, the second most powerful man in Croatia, underwent surgery in the United States last week, Croatian media reported on Tuesday.

Susak was already operated on for what was believed to be lung cancer at the Walter Reed Army Medical Center in Washington in early 1996. Rumours that he had another operation last October were never confirmed.
Croatian state radio said briefly on Monday night that Susak "underwent surgery in the United States and is feeling well". It did not say what he was suffering from.

Susak, defence minister since Croatia's independence from Yugoslavia in 1991, masterminded the buildup of the government army which retook territory held by pro-Yugoslav rebel Serbs in blitz offensives two years ago.
He is also the leader of a powerful nationalist lobby of the Bosnian Croats from Herzegovina in the Zagreb government.
